# IMPACT Recap

> Independent sermon recaps for Impact Church messages: a summary, main points, verses, and a six-day action plan for each sermon. This site is not affiliated with Impact Church.

This file is a short map of the public site. It does not control crawling, and it is not a promise that the site will be indexed or cited.

## Pages

- [Home](https://impact-recap.com/): Latest sermons
- [Library](https://impact-recap.com/library/): Browse and search every sermon recap
- [Contact](https://impact-recap.com/contact/): Questions, corrections, and bug reports
- [Privacy Policy](https://impact-recap.com/privacy/)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://impact-recap.com/terms/)
- [Accessibility](https://impact-recap.com/accessibility/)

Individual sermon pages use this pattern: https://impact-recap.com/sermons/<date>_<videoId>/

The library is the index of those pages.
